zh-CN.title: 科研资源空间
items: 课题与任务均可上传文件、添加链接，课题支持两级目录
成员共享资源，上传者与课题负责人可删除，存档后保留只读访问

en.title: Research resource spaces
items: Upload files and add links to projects and tasks, with two folder levels for projects
Share resources with members; uploaders and project owners can remove them, while archived spaces stay read-only
